question.content: Help me append the node ID to the StringBuilder `logBuilder` from a LogEvent `logEvent` in Elasticsearch, assuming the node ID is available?

function.name: NodeIdConverter.format
function.description: Appends the node ID to the provided StringBuilder if the node ID is available from the NodeAndClusterIdStateListener.

event.description: The LogEvent that contains the logging information.

toAppendTo.description: The StringBuilder to which the node ID will be appended.
